description: Permanently delete a data model. WARNING: this cascades - ALL records of the model are permanently deleted with it, and neither can be restored. Refused while another model has a relation field pointing at it (the error names those models) or while active orders reference its records. A model that no longer exists is not deleted again - the call reports that nothing matched. To change a model instead, use update_model; to remove single records, use delete_record.

idOrSlug.description: The model's id or slug (from list_models)
